text: R10: The page SHALL be accessible: body text and its background SHALL have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, every interactive element SHALL be reachable and visibly focused by keyboard, and animations SHALL be disabled WHEN the visitor's system requests reduced motion.

comments.text: R10 bundles three separate behaviours (contrast, keyboard focus, reduced motion). Consider splitting it so each can be accepted on its own, with A10 split to match. Advice only; each part is clearly stated and testable.
